schemeDescription: A Government of Madhya Pradesh scheme that provides financial assistance, capital subsidy, and interest subsidy to the sons and daughters of farmers for establishing their own businesses through bank-financed projects.
objective: To encourage entrepreneurship among farmers' families, promote self-employment, reduce unemployment, and strengthen the economic condition of rural youth in Madhya Pradesh.
ministryDepartment: Department of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of Madhya Pradesh
eligibilityCriteria: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh, aged between 18 and 45 years, belong to a farmer's family, should not be an income taxpayer, and must fulfill the scheme's prescribed conditions.
benefits: Financial assistance through bank loans ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹10,00,000. Capital subsidy of 15% for General category and up to 30% for eligible reserved categories depending on project cost. Women entrepreneurs receive 6% interest subsidy, while male entrepreneurs receive 5% interest subsidy for up to 7 years. Additional benefits are available for Bhopal Gas victim families and liberated nomadic tribes.
applicationProcess: Applicants can register online through the official Madhya Pradesh MSME portal, complete registration, log in, fill out the application form, upload the required documents, and submit the application. Offline application is also available through the concerned department.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Birth Certificate, BPL Certificate (if applicable), Land Records, Income Certificate, Address Proof, Passport Size Photograph, Mobile Number, 10th Marksheet.
beneficiaries: Sons and daughters of farmers, women entrepreneurs, BPL families, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer), minorities, disabled persons, and liberated nomadic tribes of Madhya Pradesh.
annualBenefit: Capital subsidy and interest subsidy based on project cost. Financial assistance ranges from ₹50,000 to ₹10,00,000 with interest subsidy available for up to 7 years.

schemeName: RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card
schemeDescription: A Government of India scheme under the Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) that provides Soil Health Cards to farmers after testing soil samples. The card contains detailed information about soil nutrients and recommendations for balanced fertilizer use to improve soil fertility and crop productivity.
objective: To promote soil test-based nutrient management, improve soil fertility, reduce excessive fertilizer usage, lower cultivation costs, and increase agricultural productivity through scientific soil analysis.
ministryDepartment: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
eligibilityCriteria: The applicant must be a farmer residing in India and own or cultivate agricultural land eligible for soil testing under the scheme.
benefits: Provides a Soil Health Card containing detailed soil analysis, free or affordable soil testing services, customized fertilizer recommendations, assessment of 12 important soil parameters, and guidance for improving soil fertility and crop yield. The scheme also helps farmers reduce unnecessary fertilizer expenses.
applicationProcess: Farmers can approach the District Agriculture Officer or Block Agriculture Officer for soil testing. Soil samples are collected from the farm, tested in authorized laboratories, and a Soil Health Card with recommendations is issued to the farmer.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Identity Proof, Address Proof, Land Records, Mobile Number, and any other documents required by the concerned Agriculture Department.
beneficiaries: Farmers across India who wish to assess and improve the health and fertility of their agricultural land.
annualBenefit: Free or subsidized soil testing services along with a Soil Health Card and customized nutrient management recommendations to improve productivity and reduce farming costs.

schemeName: Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship
schemeDescription: A prestigious fellowship launched by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) in association with the Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE) to recognize and support outstanding engineers and researchers engaged in translational research that leads to innovative technologies, products, devices, and processes for societal and industrial applications.
objective: To promote excellence in engineering, innovation, and technology development by encouraging translational research that transforms scientific discoveries into commercially viable and deployable technologies.
ministryDepartment: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, administered by the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB) and implemented by the Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE)
eligibilityCriteria: The applicant must be an Indian citizen or Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) working in a permanent position in a publicly funded institution in India. The applicant should possess at least a bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field, have an outstanding record in innovation or technology development, have a minimum of five years of service remaining in the parent organization, and should not be receiving any other fellowship.
educationCriteria: Minimum Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or an equivalent professional qualification.
benefits: Selected fellows receive a fellowship amount of ₹25,000 per month in addition to their regular salary, a research grant of ₹15 lakh per annum, and an institutional overhead grant of ₹1 lakh per annum. The fellowship is awarded for an initial period of three years and can be extended up to a maximum of five years based on performance.
applicationProcess: Nominations are submitted online by Heads of Institutions, Presidents or Fellows of National Science or Engineering Academies, Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Awardees, or JC Bose Awardees. Self-nominations are not accepted. The completed nomination form along with supporting documents must be emailed to the Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE). Applications are evaluated by a Search-cum-Selection Expert Committee.
requiredDocuments: Identity Proof, Passport Size Photograph, Proof of Age, Employment Certificate, Educational Qualification Certificates, Professional Awards and Recognition Details, Endorsement Certificate, Bank Account Details, and other supporting documents as required.
beneficiaries: Outstanding engineers, scientists, innovators, and technology professionals working in publicly funded institutions in India engaged in translational research.
annualBenefit: ₹3,00,000 fellowship per year (₹25,000 per month), ₹15,00,000 annual research grant, and ₹1,00,000 annual institutional overhead grant.

schemeDescription: A Government of Madhya Pradesh scheme launched by the Tribal Welfare Department to encourage Scheduled Tribe (ST) girl students to continue their education after Class 10 by providing financial assistance upon admission to Class 11.
objective: To promote higher education among Scheduled Tribe girl students, reduce dropout rates after secondary education, and encourage girls to pursue further studies through financial incentives.
ministryDepartment: Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
eligibilityCriteria: The applicant must be a girl student who is a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh, belongs to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community, is a regular student, and has passed Class 10 and taken admission in Class 11.
educationCriteria: The applicant must have passed Class 10 and be enrolled in Class 11 as a regular student.
benefits: Eligible Scheduled Tribe girl students receive a financial incentive of ₹3,000 per year. The incentive amount is directly transferred to the student's registered bank account.
applicationProcess: Applicants must first complete Aadhaar e-KYC through the Madhya Pradesh Shiksha Portal. After successful registration, they must log in to the portal, select the scheme, fill in the required details, upload the necessary documents, and submit the application. Offline application is also available through the concerned educational institution or department.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Passport Size Photograph, Samagra ID, Scheduled Tribe Caste Certificate, Bank Account Details or Passbook, Income Certificate, Madhya Pradesh Domicile Certificate, Class 10 Marksheet, and other documents as required.
schemeCategory: Education, Scholarship, Tribal Welfare, Girl Child
beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe (ST) girl students of Madhya Pradesh who have passed Class 10 and are pursuing Class 11.
annualBenefit: ₹3,000 per eligible student per year, directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.

schemeDescription: A healthcare assistance scheme launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh to provide free treatment and financial assistance for children suffering from identified congenital and acquired heart diseases. The scheme covers treatment expenses in recognized government and empanelled private hospitals.
objective: To ensure timely and quality treatment for children with heart diseases by providing financial assistance to economically weaker and Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, thereby reducing child mortality and improving access to specialized cardiac care.
ministryDepartment: Public Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
eligibilityCriteria: The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh belonging to an Economically Weaker Section (EWS) or Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. The beneficiary must be a child aged between 0 and 15 years suffering from one of the identified heart diseases. The family's name must be included in the family roster and possess a valid ration card.
benefits: Financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000 to ₹1,00,000 per eligible case for treatment and surgery of seven identified heart diseases. The scheme provides free treatment in recognized government and empanelled private hospitals, with the approved treatment cost directly transferred to the concerned medical institution.
applicationProcess: Applicants can register and apply online through the Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal or apply through Lok Sewa Kendra, MP Online, or Common Service Centre (CSC). After registration, applicants must complete the online application, upload the required documents, and submit the application for verification and approval by the concerned department.
requiredDocuments: Hospital Treatment Estimate, BPL/EWS Proof or Ration Card, Residence Certificate, Recent Passport Size Photograph, Child's Age Proof (Birth Certificate/Aadhaar Card), Hospital Expenditure Report, Utilization Certificate, Discharge Summary, and other documents prescribed by the department.
helpline: Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal Helpdesk
beneficiaries: Children aged 0 to 15 years from Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Below Poverty Line (BPL) families in Madhya Pradesh who are diagnosed with one of the notified heart diseases.
annualBenefit: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 to ₹1,00,000 per eligible child for treatment and surgery, depending on the approved medical package.

schemeDescription: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is a Government of India accident insurance scheme that provides affordable financial protection against accidental death and disability. The scheme is available to eligible bank account holders across India through an annual premium that is automatically debited from the subscriber's bank account.
objective: To provide affordable accident insurance coverage to all eligible citizens and offer financial security to individuals and their families in the event of accidental death or permanent disability.
ministryDepartment: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
eligibilityCriteria: Any individual aged between 18 and 70 years holding a savings bank or post office account in a participating bank and providing consent for auto-debit of the annual premium is eligible to enroll.
benefits: Provides accidental insurance coverage of ₹2,00,000 in case of accidental death or total permanent disability and ₹1,00,000 in case of partial permanent disability. The annual premium is only ₹20 per subscriber and is automatically debited from the linked bank account.
applicationProcess: Eligible applicants can enroll by visiting their bank branch or applying online through participating banks. The applicant must submit the enrollment form, provide consent for auto-debit of the premium, and submit the required documents. After successful enrollment, an insurance certificate is issued.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Active Savings Bank or Post Office Account, Duly Filled Enrollment Form, Mobile Number, and any other documents required by the participating bank.
beneficiaries: Eligible savings bank and post office account holders aged between 18 and 70 years across India.
annualBenefit: Accidental insurance coverage of ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or total permanent disability and ₹1,00,000 for partial permanent disability for an annual premium of ₹20.

schemeName: Financial Assistance as Interest Subsidy on Home Loan
schemeDescription: A welfare scheme by the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB), Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare, Ministry of Defence, Government of India, that provides financial assistance in the form of interest subsidy on home loans to war widows, war-disabled personnel, war-bereaved families, and attributable peacetime casualties.
objective: To reduce the financial burden of home loan repayment for eligible ex-servicemen and their families by reimbursing a portion of the interest paid on housing loans.
ministryDepartment: Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB), Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare, Ministry of Defence, Government of India
eligibilityCriteria: The applicant must be a war widow, war-bereaved family member, war-disabled personnel, or attributable peacetime casualty (all ranks). The home loan must be obtained from an approved financial institution such as a bank, Government/Public Sector Undertaking, LIC, GIC, or HUDCO. The subsidy is applicable on a loan amount up to ₹1,00,000.
benefits: The scheme reimburses 50% of the interest paid on a home loan up to ₹1,00,000. The subsidy is available for a maximum period of five years or until the loan is fully repaid, whichever is earlier.
applicationProcess: Eligible applicants must register online through the Kendriya Sainik Board Secretariat portal. After registration, applicants should complete the application form, upload the required documents, submit the application online, print the submitted application, and forward it along with supporting documents to the concerned District Sainik Board for verification. The Kendriya Sainik Board processes and approves eligible applications before releasing the subsidy.
requiredDocuments: Ex-Servicemen Identity Card, Discharge Book, Certificate from the lending institution showing interest paid, Certificate confirming regular loan repayment, Loan repayment schedule certificate, Bank Account Details, Cancelled Cheque, Aadhaar Card, Passport Size Photograph, and other documents as prescribed by the Kendriya Sainik Board.
schemeCategory: Housing, Ex-Servicemen Welfare, Interest Subsidy, Financial Assistance
helpline: Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB), Ministry of Defence
beneficiaries: War widows, war-bereaved families, war-disabled personnel, and attributable peacetime casualties who have obtained eligible home loans from approved financial institutions.
annualBenefit: Reimbursement of 50% of the interest paid on a home loan up to ₹1,00,000 for a maximum period of 5 years or until loan repayment is completed, whichever is earlier.

schemeDescription: A Government of Madhya Pradesh scheme that provides protection, legal assistance, counseling, shelter, and support services to women and children affected by domestic violence. The scheme is implemented under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.
objective: To protect women and children from domestic violence by ensuring timely access to legal protection, counseling, rehabilitation, and support services while promoting their safety, dignity, and well-being.
ministryDepartment: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh
eligibilityCriteria: All women irrespective of age who are victims of domestic violence and children below the age of 18 years affected by domestic violence are eligible to receive assistance under the scheme.
benefits: Provides protection against domestic violence, legal guidance, counseling services, rehabilitation support, referral to One Stop Centres, assistance through Protection Officers, and access to police and other government support services under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.
applicationProcess: Eligible applicants can approach the Protection Officer (Project Officer - Integrated Child Development Project Office), the One Stop Centre operating in the district, or the nearest Police Station to seek protection and assistance under the scheme.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Passport Size Photograph, Identity Proof (if required), and any supporting documents related to the complaint, if available.
schemeCategory: Women Empowerment, Child Welfare, Legal Protection, Social Welfare
beneficiaries: Women of all age groups and children below 18 years who are victims of domestic violence, including physical, sexual, emotional, mental, verbal, or economic abuse.
annualBenefit: Free access to protection services, legal assistance, counseling, rehabilitation support, and other government support services. No fixed monetary benefit is provided under the scheme.

schemeName: Investment Promotion Assistance to Setup Large/Mega/Ultra-Mega Tourism Projects
schemeDescription: A Government of Madhya Pradesh scheme that promotes investment in the tourism sector by providing capital investment assistance to private investors establishing large, mega, and ultra-mega tourism projects. The scheme aims to strengthen tourism infrastructure, generate employment, and attract private investment across the state.
objective: To encourage the establishment of world-class tourism infrastructure in Madhya Pradesh by offering financial incentives to eligible investors, increasing employment opportunities, and boosting tourism-driven economic growth.
ministryDepartment: Tourism Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
eligibilityCriteria: The applicant must be a private investor or legal entity such as a public/private limited company, LLP, partnership firm, proprietorship, cooperative, trust, or other registered organization. The applicant must satisfy the minimum investment and employment requirements based on the project category (Large, Mega, or Ultra-Mega) and ensure employment for residents of Madhya Pradesh. The applicant should not claim capital subsidy under any other category of the Tourism Policy.
benefits: Eligible projects receive Investment Promotion Assistance equal to 30% of the capital investment. Large Projects are eligible for assistance up to ₹15 crore, Mega Projects up to ₹30 crore, and Ultra-Mega Projects up to ₹90 crore. Heritage hotel projects receive relaxed investment and employment criteria. SC/ST entrepreneurs with 100% ownership receive an additional 5% capital investment subsidy. Assistance is released in phases over four years after project completion and verification.
applicationProcess: Applicants must register as an investor on the Madhya Pradesh Invest Portal, complete the required project registration, obtain all mandatory approvals, establish the tourism project, commence commercial operations, and submit the online subsidy application along with the prescribed documents within one year of commercial operation. The Tourism Department verifies the application before sanctioning the subsidy.
requiredDocuments: Company Registration Certificate, Memorandum & Articles of Association/Partnership Deed, PAN Card, Aadhaar or Identity Proof, Project Report, Land Ownership Documents, Site Map, Sale/Lease Deed, Building Permission, Approved Building Plan, TNCP Certificate, Chartered Accountant Certified Project Cost Certificate, Engineer/Valuer Certified Capital Cost Certificate, Debt Details, Completion Certificate, Proof of Commercial Operation, Unit Photographs, Cancelled Cheque, Vendor Form, and other documents prescribed by the department.
schemeCategory: Tourism, Infrastructure Development, Investment Promotion, Business Incentives
helpline: Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board / Invest MP Portal
beneficiaries: Private investors, tourism entrepreneurs, hospitality companies, heritage hotel developers, and legal entities investing in eligible tourism infrastructure projects in Madhya Pradesh.
annualBenefit: Capital investment assistance of 30% of eligible project cost up to ₹15 crore (Large), ₹30 crore (Mega), or ₹90 crore (Ultra-Mega), with an additional 5% subsidy for eligible SC/ST entrepreneurs.

schemeName: Internship Programme by the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)
schemeDescription: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), Government of India, launched this internship programme to provide young Indian students and graduates with exposure to India's foreign policy, diplomacy, international relations, and the functioning of the Ministry. The programme promotes diversity, inclusivity, and awareness of public policy while offering practical learning opportunities.
objective: To provide students and young graduates with practical exposure to the functioning of the Ministry of External Affairs, encourage interest in diplomacy and foreign policy, promote research and policy analysis, and increase participation from diverse socio-economic and geographical backgrounds.
ministryDepartment: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), Government of India
eligibilityCriteria: The applicant must be an Indian citizen with a graduate degree from a recognized university or a student in the final year of graduation where an internship is a mandatory part of the curriculum. The applicant must not be more than 25 years of age as on 31st December of the internship year. Preference is given to candidates from Aspirational Districts and applicants belonging to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS categories.
educationCriteria: Graduate from a recognized university or a final-year undergraduate student where internship is a mandatory part of the curriculum.
benefits: Selected interns receive an honorarium of ₹10,000 per month, reimbursement of one-time to-and-fro economy class airfare between their State capital (or college location) and Delhi, exposure to the functioning of the Ministry of External Affairs, opportunities to work on research and policy assignments, interaction with senior officials, and a possible visit to an Indian Mission abroad subject to prevailing conditions.
applicationProcess: Applicants must register on the official MEA Internship Portal, verify their email address, complete the online application form, upload the required documents, preview the application, and submit it online. Eligible candidates are shortlisted based on academic performance and invited for an online interview through video conferencing before the final selection.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card, Identity Proof, Address Proof, Date of Birth Proof (10th/12th Marksheet), Educational Qualification Certificates, Bank Account Details, Passport Size Photograph, Letter from Head of Institution, No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Institution (at the time of joining), and any other documents specified by MEA.
schemeCategory: Internship, Education, Skill Development, Government Training
helpline: Ministry of External Affairs Internship Portal Support
beneficiaries: Indian graduates and final-year undergraduate students from recognized universities across India who meet the eligibility criteria.
annualBenefit: Honorarium of ₹10,000 per month for up to 3 months, reimbursement of one-time economy class airfare, hands-on experience in foreign policy and diplomacy, research opportunities, and professional exposure through the Ministry of External Affairs.
